cases.oracleSource: codepoint order of the IRI strings (R5 A3 / probe T1h class), computed in this entry
cases.query: SELECT (STR(?iri) AS ?s) WHERE { VALUES ?iri { <urn:triplex:s:A1> <urn:triplex:s:E1> <urn:triplex:s:c1> <urn:triplex:s:z1> <urn:triplex:s:cE> <urn:triplex:s:cc> <urn:triplex:s:ce> } } ORDER BY STR(?iri)
SELECT ?revision WHERE {  VALUES (?revision ?order) { ("one" "01") ("two" "02") }  FILTER NOT EXISTS {  VALUES ?laterOrder { "01" "02" }  FILTER(?laterOrder > ?order) } }

SELECT ?revision WHERE { { SELECT ?revision ?order WHERE { VALUES (?revision ?order) { ("one" "01") ("two" "02") } } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { { SELECT ?laterOrder WHERE { VALUES ?laterOrder { "01" "02" } } } FILTER(?laterOrder > ?order) } }
SELECT ?revision WHERE { VALUES (?revision ?order) { ("one" "01") ("two" "02") } FILTER EXISTS { VALUES ?laterOrder { "01" "02" } FILTER(?laterOrder > ?order) } }
